judge.reason: Aggregated from MoA candidates that passed false-positive judging.

description: The /run endpoint passes user-controlled input from query parameters into a shell command executed via subprocess.check_output with shell=True, allowing arbitrary command execution.
evidence: subprocess.check_output(f"echo {name}", shell=True, text=True) at app.py line 22 where name is taken from request.args.get("name").
remediation: Invoke subprocess without shell=True using a list of arguments, or strictly validate and sanitize the input to remove shell metacharacters.
title: OS Command Injection in /run endpoint

description: A token-like secret is assigned to a module-level constant in source, exposing the credential to anyone with repository access.
evidence: Assignment of a token-like value to FAKE_FIXTURE_TOKEN at app.py line 9.
remediation: Load secrets from environment variables or a managed secrets store at runtime instead of embedding them in source.
title: Hardcoded Token Secret

description: The /search endpoint builds a SQL query via f-string interpolation of user-controlled input, enabling SQL injection.
evidence: query = f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE display_name = '{term}'" at app.py line 15 where term is taken from request.args.get("q").
remediation: Use parameterized queries with placeholder arguments (e.g., sqlite3 placeholders) rather than f-string formatting of user input.
title: SQL Injection in /search endpoint

description: Flask debug mode is enabled both via configuration and app.run, which can expose the interactive debugger and detailed error pages if the service is reachable in non-development contexts.
evidence: app.config["DEBUG"] = True and app.run(debug=True, host="127.0.0.1") at app.py line 8.
remediation: Disable debug mode for non-development deployments by setting DEBUG=False and passing debug=False to app.run().
title: Flask Debug Mode Enabled
